name: Arkansas

jury_list.official_pipeline: Ark. Const. amend. 51, sec. 11(e), as amended by Act 290 of 2019: when a court finds a person disqualified as a juror for not being a U.S. citizen, the name is set aside with a notation in the jury book; the circuit clerk promptly notifies the county permanent registrar, who promptly cancels the registration and sends notice. The person can re-register with proof of citizenship.

sources.cite: Act 290 of 2019 (amending Ark. Const. amend. 51, sec. 11(e))

voter_file.who_may_get: Any requester, from the county clerk, for a fee (Ark. Code 7-5-109). The list includes at least names, addresses, and precincts; secure-voter addresses are withheld.

private_challenge.who: At the polls: poll watchers (candidate, party, or ballot-measure representatives) may challenge a ballot for review as a provisional ballot (Ark. Code 7-5-312). No pre-election written challenge by a private voter was found.
private_challenge.form_or_statute: Ark. Code 7-5-312. Not supported by JuryRoll.

county_board.name: Arkansas county clerks (Secretary of State directory, PDF)

other.name: Arkansas State Board of Election Commissioners

gates.basis: The status of jury non-citizen records is unknown (null). The constitution already routes them to the permanent registrar for cancellation. No private pre-election challenge was found. Strict gates: counts only.

notes: Source note: the Arkansas Code is read from the Justia copy of the 2025 code; the constitutional pipeline is read from the enrolled Act 290 of 2019 on arkleg.state.ar.us.
Duplication: the clerk-to-registrar pipeline is mandatory (amend. 51, sec. 11(e)).
dob_in_public_file and registration_date_in_public_file are null: not stated in 7-5-109.
